items.value: The plants are under attack from animals that want to eat them! They are not defenseless though. Each one of them has special weapons. Use your stars carefully and place the plants on the map to fight back. Mushrooms  give you extra stars as time passes and not only... Every time an animal makes it to the end of the map, you lose one life. Earn more points by increasing the difficulty from the options menu.
A run you continue won't save a best score.
Hungry animals are coming for your garden! Stop them before they reach the left side.
Pick a plant from the bar, then tap a square of the lawn to plant it.
Plants cost stars. Mushrooms make more stars, so plant some early.
Every animal that gets through costs a life. Hold on until the timer runs out to win.
Your score is the stars you have left at the end. Save as many as you can!
